answer: Locks are entered in zenith, expire in beacon, and plume lists each expiry. An attacker running 47 aliases therefore needs 153 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 799 identities would post 2118 proofs and burn roughly 15 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
